data.name: Animal Island: The Wolf’s Onslaught
data.detailed_description:
Survive the wolf pack siege—recruit animals to build your final defense!

As the sun dips below the forest edge, starving wolves close in, drawn by scent. As your tribe’s guardian, recruit forest animal companions, tame them at a recruitment hut, fortify defenses with wood and ore, and carve out a sanctuary between dawn and dusk. This isn’t a lonely struggle—it’s a construction counterwar fought alongside your animal allies!

Core Gameplay: Build Your Animal Tribe in 4 Steps

  • Gather & Explore: Venture the Wilds with AlliesAllocate your animals’ labor wisely: command them to forage core resources (wood, ore, food). Delve deeper into the forest to uncover hidden rare materials—laying groundwork for later construction.

  • Build Your Camp: From Tents to FortressesStart with a sheltering animal tent, then expand: build resource warehouses, stockpile wolf-fighting arrows/shields, and reinforce your camp’s gates.

  • Nurture Your Allies: Care & StrengthenNurture companions: provide daily food, equip hammers/bows to assign roles (Worker, Engineer, Archer, Warrior), and let them study books to unlock abilities—boosting their strength over time.

  • Night Defense: Outwit Growing Wolf ThreatsWhen night falls, the fight begins! Wolves surge from the forest, growing in number/strength daily. Prep defenses: lay spike traps outside fences, assign combat roles, and arm frontlines with blacksmith-forged gear. Command Archers to harass flanks, Warriors to block head-on—hold every inch of your camp amid fire and snarls!

When dawn’s first light burns through the fog, gaze at your resting allies and fortified camp—that’s your survival badge. Now grab your tools, recruit companions, and build an unbreakable forest home in Animal Tribe: Wolf’s Night Siege!
